goal: 让朋友听完你的一次难忘经历

n1.speaker: 朋友 Emily
n1.line: Hey! I have heard that you have done so many interesting things. What is the most unforgettable experience you have ever had?
n1.lineCn: 嘿!我听说你做过很多有趣的事。你最难忘的经历是什么?

grammar.name: 现在完成时提问经历
grammar.note: Have you ever...? 询问过去是否发生过,强调与现在的关联。

options.text: I have traveled alone across three provinces. That was truly unforgettable!
options.textCn: 我曾独自旅行穿越三个省份。那真的很难忘!
options.feedback: 用现在完成时点出经历,引起朋友的好奇心。
拒绝分享,聊天无法继续。
答非所问,朋友问的是经历而不是物品。

n2.speaker: 朋友 Emily
n2.line: Wow, you have traveled alone? I have never been brave enough to do that. What happened on the trip?
n2.lineCn: 哇,你独自旅行过?我从没勇气这么做。旅途上发生了什么?

grammar.name: have + 过去分词
grammar.note: I have never been brave enough... 现在完成时强调从过去到现在从未有过。

options.text: I have climbed a mountain at sunrise and I have met three kind old farmers on the way.
options.textCn: 我在日出时爬过一座山,途中还遇到了三位善良的老农。
options.feedback: 用两个现在完成时具体描述经历,画面感很强。
信息太少,朋友完全不知道你经历了什么。

options.text: It has been a long time, I do not remember.
options.textCn: 已经过去很久了,我不记得了。
options.feedback: 自己都忘了,这段经历也很难讲出来。

n3.speaker: 朋友 Emily
n3.line: Come on, everyone has had at least one special moment. Has anything interesting ever happened to you?
n3.lineCn: 别这样,每个人都有至少一个特别的时刻。你身上有没有发生过什么有趣的事?

grammar.name: Has anything ever happened...?
grammar.note: 现在完成时疑问句,询问是否曾经发生过,ever 加强语气。

options.text: Actually, I have once gotten lost in the city for a whole night. That is a long story!
options.textCn: 其实,我曾经在城里迷路了一整晚。这说来话长!
options.feedback: 找到了一个值得讲的经历,把话题拉了回来。

options.text: I have told you, nothing happened to me.
options.textCn: 我说过了,什么都没发生过。
options.feedback: 再次拒绝,朋友也不再想追问了。

n4.speaker: 朋友 Emily
n4.line: That sounds amazing! Have you ever done anything like that again since then?
n4.lineCn: 听起来太棒了!从那以后,你有没有再做过类似的事?

grammar.name: since 引导的时间状语
grammar.note: since then 与现在完成时连用,表示"从那之后到现在"。

options.text: I have been to the seaside twice since then, and I have made many friends there.
options.textCn: 从那以后我去过海边两次,在那里交了很多朋友。
options.feedback: 用现在完成时继续展开,经历越讲越丰满。
话题到这里断了,经历没讲完。

n5.speaker: 朋友 Emily
n5.line: Well, try to remember something. Has anything exciting ever happened to you in your life?
n5.lineCn: 好吧,试着回忆一下。你人生中有没有发生过什么激动人心的事?

grammar.name: Has anything...happened?
grammar.note: 疑问词 anything 与现在完成时搭配,表示"是否发生过什么"。

options.text: Yes! I have once won first prize in a speech contest. I have never forgotten that day.
options.textCn: 有!我曾在一场演讲比赛中得过一等奖。我从没忘记那一天。
options.feedback: 终于讲出了具体经历,还用了两个现在完成时。

options.text: I have forgotten everything. I really cannot think of any.
options.textCn: 我全忘了,真的想不起来任何事。
options.feedback: 一再推脱,朋友只好放弃追问。

n6.speaker: 朋友 Emily
n6.line: That is really wonderful! Thank you so much for sharing this with me. I have learned a lot about you today.
n6.lineCn: 真的太棒了!非常感谢你和我分享这些。今天我对你有了很多了解。

grammar.name: 现在完成时表持续
grammar.note: I have learned a lot... 表示到现在为止已经了解了很多。

options.text: Thanks for listening! Maybe we can make our own memories together next time.
options.textCn: 谢谢你听我说!也许下次我们也可以一起创造我们的回忆。
options.feedback: 顺利讲完经历,还邀约下次一起玩,对话圆满结束。
突然离开,辜负了朋友的热情,经历也不算真正聊完。

success.speaker: 朋友 Emily
success.line: Deal! I cannot wait to hear more of your stories next time!
success.lineCn: 说定了!我等不及下次再听你的故事了!

fail1.speaker: 朋友 Emily
fail1.line: Okay... maybe you just do not want to talk. Let us talk about something else then.
fail1.lineCn: 好吧……也许你只是不想说。那我们聊点别的吧。

fail2.speaker: 朋友 Emily
fail2.line: Oh, sure. See you later then. It was nice talking to you.
fail2.lineCn: 哦,好的。那回头见,和你聊天很开心。
